trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 awards on the PS5 base-game list. Start with the Chapter 1 meditation warning, then follow the story. After the credits, compare your console list with the in-game 100% screen. They track different objectives, and you'll need both for platinum.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play as Jason immediately after the prologue in Mariana County. Follow Cal's mission through the package pickups and Donnie's rescue, then return the seaplane to Brian's Marina. Finishing that first trip earns the story award.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep going past Discharge Time. At the Starlet Motel, finish What's in the Bag? as Lucia. This chapter award can appear on the far side of the transition, so check the list after completing that opening Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: After Checking Out, stay with the story through Welcome to Vice City. Your move to the Bayside apartment marks the Chapter 3 transition and the end-of-Chapter-2 award.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Play into Chapter 4. Finish Ocean Beach and Another Life before checking your trophies. Reaching the new chapter title alone can be too early to see the previous chapter's medal.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Follow the main markers through Starting From Zero at the close of Chapter 4. Complete the mission before checking for the chapter medal. Optional errands can wait.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Stay on the main story path until the final mission resolves. Check the PS5 list after its closing sequence. Local completion percentages and optional objectives are separate from this automatic award.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Wait for Jason's call after Slam Dunk in Chapter 2. As Lucia, return to the Starlet Motel and play Breakfast Run through to its ending. No optional mission score is needed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: In Chapter 3, clear Hidden Charges and the remaining main markers. Meet Raul's crew in the Stockyard for The Cartel Heist. Follow the whole mission through its payout to collect the story medal.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: In Chapter 4, follow the main objective for Child's Play. Finish the mission and wait for the transition back to play before checking the trophy list. Its objectives are on the critical story path.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Keep Headliners on your Chapter 4 route. Play its main marker through the closing objective. This award is attached to mission progress and requires no separate activity medal.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Continue the Chapter 4 story to VCIA Takedown. Follow its mission objectives all the way to the finish. Visiting the airport independently advances a different trophy.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: During Chapter 5, play Operation Savage Glory as part of the main sequence. If the medal is still locked, check which main mission you last finished before searching for an optional event.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: After the story, open Progress → Stats → 100% Completion. Use the remaining categories to choose each trip. For example, the stunt trophy arrives at 250, while this checklist asks for 300. Earlier exploration already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Combine ramp jumps, bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps. Use the regional stunt totals in Progress to pick new ones. Stop at 250 for this trophy, or carry on to 300 during the same route for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Use Progress → Activities to find a category with no result. Work through fishing, hunting, golf, range, pool, basketball, video games, racing and stunts. Do one of each and look for the activity counter to advance.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Visit Griffin Shooting Range and Rodgers Ranch. Buy the waiver from each clerk, then use the challenge menu to find any medal still below gold. Griffin accounts for 18 golds and Rodgers for 24. Finish all 42.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Use the Top Fun Drones filter in Map → Activities. At each of the 14 venues, beat a timed race before moving on. For the separate 100% checklist, return for the rest of the 42 courses.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Open Progress → Activities → Racing and choose a race without a win. Several events share a starting location, so check the event name each time. Win 20 different events. The longer 100% route asks for 30.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: During Chapter 1, meet Cal in Feng Shui. Watch for his text and the purple fishing marker. Join his fishing activity and keep following his challenges until you beat him.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Start at the controllers by the home TV and choose one game, such as Street Trash III. Finish its entire set of levels. A high score or one cleared level won't finish the game. The TV is available again after the story.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: As Lucia in Chapter 3, answer Andy's call and follow the address she texts in Belville. Continue her Cellerica jobs to the end of the strand. You can return in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Watch for Kenton's KR in Key Lento after Island Dreams. Dive the wrecks he marks, then bring each batch back so he can issue the next. If his icon disappears after Chapter 1, continue the story and watch Jason's texts.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, visit Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Follow Billy's jobs through Hometown Heroes. The club strand remains available for post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish entire stranger strands and check the PS5 counter after each ending. Kirk's search for Mr. Mangrove and Kyle's McKittrick Farm encounters are known examples. Named contact missions don't all count toward the required eight.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs in Chapter 3. Open Randy's Wish List under Map → Robberies and match the requested cars. Deliver all 16 models and follow Randy's last objective to finish the strand.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: As Jason, finish Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3 and follow Tyrone's purple lab markers in Vice City. Clearing his first set of objectives opens Spin On This. Finish that follow-up job for the medal.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: During Chapter 1, check Jason's kitchen in the morning after Down to Earth. When Lucia heads to the balcony, join her and accept the meditation. Later, check Progress → Collections → Exploration → Meditations and revisit spots with both characters.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Look for a text to Jason from Bret after Coffee Break. Meet him in Lummox County and follow one of his marked Target Deck assignments. Bring the requested unique animal back to Bret to close the job.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Choose three nearly complete sets in Collections. Check wall displays and yellow phone boxes for missing cards. Selling a found card at a pawn shop keeps its collection entry. The longer 100% route requires 15 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open WAiNK on the in-game phone and scan distinct marked subjects. Mix landmarks, sculptures and curiosities while uncovering the map. Change districts when nearby subjects are already registered and build the count to 100.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Go to Progress → Challenges and look for entries without the completed check. Rotate through different objectives until 50 show as finished. Keep the same save for A Long Road, which asks for 70 of the available 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break lets you call your partner, do the Chapter 4 vault introduction together. That activity produces the required four stars. Keep the pair together until the red heat zone clears as well.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, call your partner and use the game's green shop markers. Finish three shop encounters within one continuous wanted-level sequence. Watch the flashing stars between objectives. A cleared level breaks the chain.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone scanner on unfamiliar vehicles. Try a marina or an airfield when street traffic starts repeating. Scanning a new model records the discovery without needing to own or drive it.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Watch the purple Focus meter during a combat mission. With a full meter, activate the game's Combat Focus ability and register five enemy takedowns before that activation ends. A second activation starts a separate attempt.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Go to the departure terminals at VCIA. Select a passenger jet connected to a boarding bridge and follow the in-game aircraft controls to fly it away. A parked plane elsewhere on the airfield doesn't meet the same condition.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Look for the Rhino vehicle at Mile Zero Air Station in southwestern Mariana County. Use its in-game vehicle action during the encounter and watch for the PS5 unlock. A tank sighting alone does not complete the challenge.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to unlock the jewelry marker and Snap Gun interaction. Select a jewelry encounter and complete its stealth objective without triggering detection. Use the game's detection feedback to judge a retry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where the Money Is… to start the vault activity. Finish its escape objective and check your PS5 counter. Complete further vault events until five successful escapes are registered.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Pick up That's Where the Money Is… from the Chapter 4 café marker. Follow this optional mission through its escape phase. The introductory vault sequence can also award the armored-truck trophy.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Open the map and look for remaining dark areas. Fly over the gaps, then reopen the map and check narrow coastal strips and islands. Keep working outward until Leonida's fog has cleared.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Open Progress → Gangs and choose a faction whose operations total is still zero. Use its yellow activity marker to complete one operation. Repeat across the nine gangs. The 100% checklist separately counts all 39 sites.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: In Ocean Beach, go up to the Ocean Hotel's rooftop bar. Purchase a cocktail there and finish drinking it while on the roof. The filmed unlock shows the particular bar to use.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 3 Key Cloner mission for Randy, visit the showroom in southern Vice City. Use the blue Banshee for the game's showroom-window stunt. Keep driving after it lands to allow the unlock to register.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Enter Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2 in Port Gellhorn. Collect the event's three key valuables, including the office watch and the Gutterball, then finish the escape. The operation can respawn for anything left behind.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: After Coffee Break, bring both partners to a fitness club and train together. Check Strength on each character's pause-menu page. Both meters need to reach maximum at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Enable Criminal Profile alerts in the HUD settings. Play activities that register a profile change and use the trophy counter to check progress toward 500. Different profile changes contribute, so keep your preferred play style.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The published clue points to a second attempt. Neither the destination nor the triggering action is verified in the linked guides. Keep a separate story save and leave this slot open until your console confirms it. The prologue connection is an unverified lead.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: In Kelly County after 2 a.m. in game, look for a parked car with flickering lights at the location in the linked video. Continue up the road, speak to the stranger after the encounter and return to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Try the game's mounted melee action during a motorcycle encounter. The PS5 hint specifies a melee drive-by. The exact target count and timing remain unconfirmed in the linked roadmap, so use the trophy notification as your finish signal.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 for access to marked bills. Take accumulated bills from the game's robbery activities to a fence such as Yasmani in Vice City. Several deliveries can contribute to the $250,000 total.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Count ordinary shopping toward this total while playing. Vehicle modifications and tattoos are two ways to advance it when you have cash left over. Spend a cumulative $100,000 across shops.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Finish Daily Driver in Chapter 2 and open Vice City Real Estate on the phone. Buy the eight available garages as funds allow. Budget $160,000 for the purchases. The four story garages are tracked separately.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: In Chapter 2, take a vehicle to Moses to gain the Scooter Bros app. Add garage spaces, then bring eligible vehicles to his Port Gellhorn shop and use Respray and Register. Repeat until ten registrations appear.
